title: Data Engineer - Senior Analyst
description:
• Build and optimise data pipelines using Java (preferred) or Python.
  • Develop real-time streaming and batch data pipelines.
  • Work with Kafka, Flink or Spark, with Kafka/Flink preferred.
  • Develop AWS-based data solutions using Kinesis, MSK, Lambda and Glue.
  • Implement data governance, lineage, security and quality controls.
  • Support CI/CD using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
  • Use Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.
  • Deploy containerised workloads using Docker, Kubernetes and AWS EKS.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/ML, product and engineering teams.
